Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red light in the left lane of the roadway in Pasadena, Texas, when Driver 2 faield to stop in
time and struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact pushed Driver 1's car forawrd into the intersection, and the
damage to the rear bumper, trunk lid and tail light assembly is consistent with the force descriebd by both drivers.
Driver 2 stated that the light had changed and that the brakes did not respond quickly enough on a wet pavement
surface. Two independent witnesses on the adjoining sidewalk gave statements that matched this account, and
photographs taken at the scene show the same damage pattern. Officers found no prior damage to the vehicle in any
records or observations made at the scene. Passenger was seated in the front right seat and was confirmed present
by both drivers and by both witnesses. Passenger reported pain in the left knee after the collision and was evaluated
at the scene, wehre the reported injury was considered plausible given the driection and force of the impact. Driver 1
is listed as a member of the policyholder's household and was operating the vehicle with permission.
